sources: Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars (Gaia Collaboration, Smart et al. 2021), ESA/Gaia/DPAC
query: SELECT source_id, dist_50, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, wd_prob FROM external.gaiaedr3_gcns_main_1 WHERE dist_50 < 0.1 AND MOD(source_id, 10) = 0 AND phot_bp_mean_flux_over_error > 10 AND phot_rp_mean_flux_over_error > 10 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND phot_bp_rp_excess_factor > 1.0 + 0.015 * POWER(phot_bp_mean_mag - phot_rp_mean_mag, 2) AND phot_bp_rp_excess_factor < 1.3 + 0.06 * POWER(phot_bp_mean_mag - phot_rp_mean_mag, 2)
